Memory and files

  searching, so a second run continues instead of repeating. Same on a laptop or a server.

Three rules from a fifth field test (Latvia)
- Resolve a named list before searching wider — 16 of 31 association members went undecided
  because the budget went on finding new names instead of deciding the ones already held.
- One row is the manager, not the funds it operates.
- Two headquarters: record the first the firm lists, name the second in the report.

Honesty and privacy
- Real company names and one ruling-family name replaced with placeholders, and a false
  claim that all names were already placeholders removed.
- A fabricated size measurement removed and the episode recorded.
- Sample CSVs (test-estonia.csv, sources-estonia.csv) no longer ship. They were a set of
  claims about themselves that kept going stale as the rules moved. The schema, the column
  meanings and the citation format all remain; run it to see real output.
